text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every three months as indicated 
by M3 or after Shutdown in the title block.
The first initiated by eng. Mohamed 
Mostafa El-Zalabany, tested by eng. Samir Ouf Hassoub, accepted by 
general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector 
of Damanhour power station, and 
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia Diab WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safety category
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safety category
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your 
 safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. etc
Switch off the CB and 
 withdraw it from its cell.
Switch off the DC power 
 supply for this CB.
Tools and Equipment
Electrical equipment kit.
Electrical equipment kit.
Dry Cloth, dry air from air 
 blower.
Work to be carried out
Complete Clean for Circuit 
 breaker.
Check the closing and opening 
 order.
Check the Inter-Lock for gas 
 pressure.
